nodes.label: Phase 1: Wallet Adapter and App Shell
nodes.norm_label: phase 1: wallet adapter and app shell

nodes.label: D2: better-sqlite3 Directly (No ORM)
nodes.rationale: Simpler, fewer dependencies, full control over queries. Drizzle adds complexity not needed for this scope. Migrations are plain SQL files.

nodes.label: D4: Demo Ledger is Server-Side
nodes.rationale: Server-side verification must work identically in demo and real mode. A client-side demo ledger would bypass the verification pipeline.

nodes.label: Switching from Demo to Real Mode
nodes.norm_label: switching from demo to real mode

nodes.label: D15: Real-Mode Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: SDK sign() returns hex publicKey and signature. Nimiq uses Ed25519 for basic accounts. Exact verification library/method needs confirmation.

nodes.label: D3: JWT for Sessions
nodes.rationale: Simple, no session table needed. Demo mode generates JWTs the same way for consistency. Short expiry (24h) with refresh on activity.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Read Validation and Weekly Pool
nodes.norm_label: phase 4: read validation and weekly pool

nodes.label: D6: Read Validation — Server-Driven, Probabilistic
nodes.rationale: Any client-side validation can be spoofed. Multiple weak signals (timing, quiz, device, IP) layered for reasonable confidence. Perfect Sybil resistance is out of scope.

nodes.label: D7: Luna Everywhere, NIM Only in Display
nodes.norm_label: d7: luna everywhere, nim only in display
nodes.rationale: Avoids floating-point errors. 1 NIM = 100,000 Luna. Conversion happens in shared helpers and Vue filters.

nodes.label: D16: Validator List
nodes.rationale: Mock validator list in demo mode. Real mode: fetch from public Nimiq staking API (endpoint TBD). No public validators API endpoint found in mini-app docs.

nodes.label: D9: Tailwind CSS for Styling
nodes.rationale: Rapid mobile-first development. Utility classes keep component files self-contained. Custom theme with gold, blue, navy palette.

nodes.label: D11: Monorepo with npm Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Zero extra tooling. packages/shared referenced by both apps/web and apps/api via workspace protocol.

nodes.label: D14: crypto.getRandomValues Fallback for UUIDs
nodes.rationale: Nimiq Pay WebView over HTTP (local dev) is not a secure context; crypto.randomUUID() may be unavailable.

nodes.label: D1: Hono over Express
nodes.rationale: Lighter, faster, better TypeScript support, built-in middleware. Deploys easily as a Node.js service.

nodes.label: D12: Single Deploy Target
nodes.rationale: Simplifies deployment. One Dockerfile, one process, one HTTPS origin. API routes under /api/*, SPA for everything else.

nodes.label: D10: markdown-it + DOMPurify
nodes.rationale: Spec requirement. Prevents XSS while allowing rich markdown content. html option set to false.

nodes.label: D5: No Escrow for Requests
nodes.rationale: Spec requirement. Avoids custodial complexity and legal risk. Trade-off: an Awarded-unpaid state is possible; surfaced publicly as reputation pressure.

nodes.label: D13: Spanish as Second Language
nodes.rationale: Large Nimiq community in Latin America. Demonstrates the i18n scaffold works.

nodes.label: D8: App Name in One Config
nodes.norm_label: d8: app name in one config
nodes.rationale: Easy to rename. APP_NAME constant in packages/shared/src/config.ts. Used in UI text, page titles, and API responses.
